''See also: [[Blackflame Empire Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Blackflame]] Empire is a vast territory located in the east, encompassing diverse landscapes such as deserts and lush expanses. Historically, the empire was founded by the [[Blackflame family]], who ruled through overwhelming force and a specialized [[madra]] that mimicked Black dragons{{!}}black dragons. This original dynasty eventually collapsed after their power consumed them from within, leaving behind a legacy of devastation and a landscape scarred by their intense energy. A subsequent empire of the same name was later formed from the remnants of the old one. Currently, the empire is governed by the [[Naru clan]], which took control from the [[Blackflame family]] approximately fifty years ago. The current leader is Naru Huan{{!}}Emperor Naru Huan, an [[Underlord]] who maintains order through a highly organized and categorized social structure. Despite this organization, the empire faces significant instability due to external threats from [[dragons]], incursions from the [[Trackless Sea]], and internal pressures from various factions and potential [[Dreadgod]] rampages. The empire's defense relies on specialized groups like the [[Skysworn]], as well as advanced [[constructs]] and boundary fields. While it remains a significant power, the empire is currently described as being in a state of decline and vulnerability.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Located far to the east, the [[Blackflame]] Empire is a civilization that serves as the home of the [[Jai clan]]. This territory is characterized by a lack of harvesters similar to those utilized by Miners{{!}}miners and features a remote range of mountains along its southern edge. While the empire contains only a handful of Underlord{{!}}Underlords, [[Eithan]] serves the realm in this capacity. Additionally, the empire is a potential destination for the relocation of [[Jai Long]]'s sister.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The [[Blackflame]] Empire is a territory composed of various clans that was originally established by a family discovering a source of [[dragon]] power. While the empire utilizes a strict ranking and categorization system for all things, the Emperor has struggled to maintain full control over its entire scope for two generations. The empire's western borders are defined by the mountains located to the west of the [[Desolate Wilds]]. After being taken back into the empire for training by a young [[Underlord]], [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] arrive at this destination, where the value of a single superior-grade [[scale]] far exceeds that of [[Lindon]]'s own [[scales]]. Although [[Eithan]] is not entirely from this land, his arrival within the empire has made a significant impact.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Located at the southern edge of a lush green expanse, the [[Blackflame]] Empire is a territory owned by the [[Akura clan]] and ruled by an emperor. While it is a place where killing an [[Underlord]] is difficult, the original empire met its demise during the last awakening of the [[Corrupted ones]]. Under the leadership of [[Naru Huan]], the empire is a land where the green armor of the [[Skysworn]] is highly respected and where [[inhabitants]] may employ strategies of fleeing like mice when facing overwhelming natural disasters. During a duel that takes place within its borders, [[Lindon]] finds himself in the southern portion of the empire. Notably, no one within this realm possesses the space-control abilities held by the [[Akura family Matriarch]] or her disciples.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Following the fall of the [[Jai clan]] and preceding the rise of the [[Arelius family]], the [[Blackflame]] Empire existed as a fractured and lawless region where competition between [[Monarch]] disciples often spilled over. During a selection process, an army bearing various faction symbols streamed through a tall column of darkness to establish a camp behind [[Orthos]]. While the empire utilizes [[Skysworn]] as scouts and treats its rare Underlord{{!}}Underlords like kings, the thin [[aura]] of the realm makes it significantly weaker than locations like [[Night Wheel Valley]]. After defending territory within the valley amidst potential threats from the [[Seishen Kingdom]], the empire began a retreat. Following these events, [[Akura Charity]] addressed the people of the empire and promised a gift in compensation, though she did not select [[Lindon]] as one of their three competitors.}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Blackflame]] Empire is the ancestral home of [[Orthos]]'s [[dragon]] lineage and shares a naming culture with the [[Ninecloud]] country. As a vassal team in the Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned King tournament, its Fate{{!}}fate is tied to the competition's outcome while major families vie for control of the empire. The team, which includes representatives such as Death Monarch Yerin Arelius{{!}}Yerin Arelius and descendants of Arelius family{{!}}House Arelius, is currently en route to the [[tournament]]. Within this group are members like Eithan{{!}}Eithan Arelius and individuals whom [[Lindon]] seeks to prevent from falling into [[dragon]] hands. During the events, [[Naru Saeya]] works to spread the empire's name, and one of its fighters is matched against the final descendant of their original royal family.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Blackflame]] Empire is a significant territory where [[Eithan]] spent much of his life, and it serves as a primary focus for those training to prevent its potential invasion. The empire contains [[sacred artists]] who have been transported to the [[Night Wheel Valley]] and employs workers from the [[Arelius family]]. As a region threatened by the impending arrival of the [[Dreadgods]], it faces the necessity of evacuation and has already been targeted by [[Redmoon Emissaries]]. During these conflicts, the empire humiliated Prince Seishen Kiro{{!}}Kiro before his death, and a group is expected to emerge within its western reaches.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Situated beyond the [[Desolate Wilds]], the [[Blackflame]] Empire serves as a protective domain that encompasses the western region of [[Orthos]]. During its history, the empire was the site where the [[Bleeding Phoenix]] was witnessed, though it notably lacks an [[Archlord]]. While the empire is considered too weak to attract the attention of the [[Wandering Titan]], it has faced internal instability as the [[Jai clan]] was pushed out of its central territories.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The [[Blackflame]] Empire is a massive territory protected by the [[Wastelanders]]. Within its borders, clerks and administrators manage recruitment efforts for a vast empire that possesses many subordinates. While the empire is large enough to send fleets of cloudships, most of its [[sacred artists]] struggle to overcome the barrier of advancing to [[Underlord]]. Although [[Jai Long]] seeks to avoid blending into this location, [[Malice]] has forces arrayed around its perimeter. Furthermore, the empire remains within striking range of the fighting between [[Monarchs]].}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Located in [[Ashwind]], the [[Blackflame]] Empire was historically governed by Black dragons{{!}}black dragon emperors. == Notable quotes ==
